articles.title: Analyze This: Microbes can make valuable chemicals more sustainable
articles.snippet: Food waste-fed bacteria may someday make chemical ingredients for medicines, cosmetics and more.
articles.summary: Bacteria fed on food waste might one day be used to create chemical ingredients for medicines and cosmetics. This process could make the production of valuable chemicals much more sustainable.

articles.title: Let’s learn about how particles act like waves
articles.snippet: So-called “wave-particle duality” is one of the strangest parts of quantum physics.
articles.summary: Wave-particle duality is one of the strangest parts of quantum physics. This concept describes how particles act like waves.

articles.title: Would growing a big heart make the Grinch strong?
articles.snippet: In the classic Dr. Seuss tale, the Grinch’s heart grows in an instant. That probably wouldn’t have been good for him — unless he was a snake.
articles.summary: In the classic Dr. Seuss story, the Grinch's heart grows instantly, which probably would not have been good for him. However, this sudden growth might have been good for him if he was a snake.
